items.source: Provide a simple template method that calls createTagWriter() and passes the created TagWriter to the writeTagContent(TagWriter) method.
items.translation: 提供一个简单的模板方法，该方法调用createTagWriter()，并将创建的TagWriter传递给writeTagContent(TagWriter)方法。

items.source: Subclasses (or test classes) can override the createTagWriter() method to redirect output to a Writer other than the JspWriter associated with the current PageContext.
items.translation: 子类（或测试类）可以重写createTagWriter()方法，将输出重定向到与当前PageContext关联的JspWriter之外的其他Writer。

items.source: Subclasses should implement the writeTagContent(TagWriter) to perform actual tag rendering.
items.translation: 子类应实现writeTagContent(TagWriter)以执行实际的标签渲染。

items.source: The default implementation simply returns the given value as-is.
items.translation: 默认实现直接返回给定的值。

items.source: Optionally writes the supplied value under the supplied attribute name into the supplied TagWriter. In this case, the supplied value is evaluated first and then the String representation is written as the attribute value. If the resultant String representation is null or empty, no attribute is written.
items.translation: 可选地将提供的值写入到提供的TagWriter中指定的属性名下。在这种情况下，首先对提供的值进行评估，然后将字符串表示形式写入为属性值。如果生成的String表示形式为null或为空，则不写入任何属性。

items.source: Create the TagWriter which all output will be written to. By default, the TagWriter writes its output to the JspWriter for the current PageContext. Subclasses may choose to change the Writer to which output is actually written.
items.translation: 创建 TagWriter，所有输出都将写入该对象。默认情况下，TagWriter 将其输出写入当前 PageContext 的 JspWriter。子类可以选择更改实际写入输出的 Writer。

items.source: Get the display value of the supplied Object, HTML escaped as required. If the supplied value is not a String and the supplied PropertyEditor is not null then the PropertyEditor is used to obtain the display value.
items.translation: 获取提供的 `Object` 的显示值，并按需进行 HTML 转义。如果提供的值不是 String，且提供的 PropertyEditor 不为 null，则使用该 PropertyEditor 来获取显示值。

items.source: Get the display value of the supplied Object, HTML escaped as required. This version is not PropertyEditor-aware.
items.translation: 获取提供的 `Object` 的显示值，并按需进行 HTML 转义。此版本 不 支持 PropertyEditor。

items.source: Create the TagWriter which all output will be written to.
items.translation: 创建 `TagWriter`，所有输出都将写入其中。

items.source: Optionally writes the supplied value under the supplied attribute name into the supplied TagWriter.
items.translation: 可选地将提供的值写入到提供的属性名称下，至提供的 TagWriter。

items.source: Get the display value of the supplied Object, HTML escaped as required.
items.translation: 获取提供的 `Object` 的显示值，并按需进行 HTML 转义。

items.source: Overridden to default to true in case of no explicit default given.
items.translation: 覆盖为在没有显式默认值的情况下默认为 `true`。

items.source: Subclasses should implement this method to perform tag content rendering.
items.translation: 子类应实现此方法以执行标签内容渲染。

items.source: doStartTagInternal in class RequestContextAwareTag
items.translation: `doStartTagInternal` 在类 `RequestContextAwareTag` 中

items.source: isDefaultHtmlEscape in class HtmlEscapingAwareTag
items.translation: `isDefaultHtmlEscape` 在类 `HtmlEscapingAwareTag` 中

items.source: the value returned by writeTagContent(TagWriter)
items.translation: 由 `writeTagContent(TagWriter)` 返回的值

items.source: Evaluate the supplied value for the supplied attribute name.
items.translation: 评估所提供属性名称的给定值。

items.source: Exception - any exception, any checked one other than a JspException gets wrapped in a JspException by doStartTag
items.translation: `Exception` - 任何异常，除 JspException 以外的任何受检异常都会由 doStartTag 包装在 JspException 中。

items.source: valid tag render instruction as per Tag.doStartTag().
items.translation: 按 `Tag.doStartTag()` 中的有效标签渲染指令。

items.source: Rob Harrop, Juergen Hoeller
items.translation: Rob Harrop，Juergen Hoeller
